items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium that could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could result in security feature bypass and privilege escalation.

items.title: Urgent Action Required Critical Security Update Available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A zero-day vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650), also known as StyleSmuggler, allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on an affected installation and has been actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin addresses a critical unauthenticated customer account takeover vulnerability (CVE-2026-71362) with a CVSS score of 9.1, along with other stored cross-site scripting and authorization flaws.

items.title: CVE-2026-48358: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: This RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce is caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction and requiring no authentication.
